title: Domain-Driven Design Tactical Patterns — Companion Files
title_es: Patrones Tácticos de Domain-Driven Design — Archivos complementarios
description: Runnable tactical DDD examples: a Money value object, an Order aggregate with domain events, repository + Unit of Work + application service with in-memory persistence, a cross-aggregate pricing domain service, composable specifications, and a Java anti-corruption layer.
description_es: Ejemplos tácticos de DDD ejecutables: un value object Money, un aggregate Order con domain events, repository + Unit of Work + application service con persistencia en memoria, un domain service de pricing cross-aggregate, specifications componibles y un anti-corruption layer en Java.
